title: Updating the current walk code
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $15$ of its register vector by $z$ yields the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its current walk code $cur$ by $z$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating the vector associated with
$\sigma$ at register index $15$ to $z$ gives the vector associated with the state
obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its current walk code $\mathrm{cur}$ with $z$.
